selection: Two repair cases per level; one from each source group; selected for rule and failure diversity, not success rate estimation.

cases.title: A narrow M1 waist
cases.issue: The blue M1 route has a 12 nm waist between wider ends. M1.W.1 marks the narrow section.
cases.fix: Restore the waist from 12 to 24 nm. Keep both end anchors fixed. The reference adds 600 nm2 of M1.

cases.title: Too little M2 enclosure around V1
cases.issue: The V1 via has only 2 nm of M2 extension on the checked opposite sides. The enclosure check requires more metal around it.
cases.fix: Extend M2 on both checked sides: enclosure grows from 2 to 7 nm. The via stays in place. The reference adds 180 nm2 of M2.

cases.title: A small gap and a narrow M3 route
cases.issue: Two M1 shapes have a 12 nm gap. A separate M3 shape is also only 12 nm wide. Both defects must be repaired in the correct instance.
cases.fix: Move one M1 shape by 8 nm to give a 20 nm gap. Widen M3 from 12 to 24 nm. Preserve the repeated masters and all instance transforms.

cases.title: Small M1 area inside rotated hierarchy
cases.issue: The M1 pad has area 288 nm2 and a 12 nm short dimension. M1 area and width fail. A nearby M3 route also fails width.
cases.fix: Grow the M1 pad to 576 nm2 with an 18 nm short dimension. Widen M3 from 12 to 24 nm. Apply the change to the permitted route instance.
